summary_1line: Bhishma praises righteous sages and begins a tale where King Vrishadarbha protects a terrified pigeon seeking refuge from a pursuing hawk.

image_candidates.scene_text: A frightened pigeon falls into King Vrishadarbha’s lap in the royal court while a fierce hawk swoops down from the sky after it.
The compassionate king gently cups the trembling pigeon in his hands, promising protection even at the cost of his kingdom and life.
A sharp-eyed hawk confronts the king, wings spread and talons bloodstained, arguing that the pigeon is its rightful prey.
